schemes.title: Karnataka Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.description: State post-matric financial assistance for eligible SC/ST students studying in post-secondary and degree institutions in Karnataka.

schemes.title: Vidyasiri - Food and Accommodation Scheme (BCWD Karnataka)
schemes.department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.description: Monthly stipend of ₹1,500 for 10 months to students from backward classes who do not get hostel admission, assisting with boarding and lodging.

schemes.title: Karnataka State Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
schemes.department: Directorate of Minorities, Government of Karnataka
schemes.description: Maintenance allowance and academic fee reimbursement for notified minority community students pursuing graduation and post-graduation in Karnataka.
